written.myAnswer: Graphene is a single layer of carbon atoms arranged in hexagonal rings, whereas graphite consists of many such layers stacked together.

Allotropic forms are different structural forms of the same element. The main allotropes of carbon are diamond, graphite and Buckminster fullerene (C₆₀). Diamond has a giant macromolecular structure; graphite consists of layers of hexagonal carbon rings; and C₆₀ is a cage-like sphere with carbon atoms arranged in pentagons and hexagons. Sulphur has two crystalline allotropes, rhombic and monoclinic sulphur; rhombic sulphur is more stable. Coal is an impure, non-crystalline form of carbon, while diamond is a crystalline form with a giant macromolecular structure.
Graphene conducts electricity very well, which makes it useful in electronics.
